Find the inverse of $f(x) = 3x-5$, and verify by computing $f(f^{-1}(x))$.
questions.answer: Swap and solve: $x=3y-5 \Rightarrow y=\frac{x+5}{3}$, so $f^{-1}(x)=\frac{x+5}{3}$. Check: $f(f^{-1}(x)) = 3\cdot\frac{x+5}{3}-5 = x+5-5=x$. ✓

questions.answer: Adding the equations: $3x=9$, so $x=3$; then $y=7-2(3)=1$. Solution: $(3,1)$.
